'''2010 US West Nationals Day 1 John Anderson DS Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[John Anderson]] at [[2010 US West Nationals]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe|SE-D-huntdownanddestroythejedi.gif}}
* '''Username:''' puck71
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
